finding_evidence.classification: materially incomplete governing source conditions / unsupported categorical product-fit limitation
finding_evidence.title: Snipe-IT default QR destination is treated as the built-in capability boundary
finding_evidence.candidate_claim: Its built-in QR leads to the private asset page, not the public care page.
finding_evidence.independent_finding: The rolling Asset Labels page describes an in-system QR path, but the release actually discussed, v8.8.0 (2c466fa8a5a68525439bf1bbbc24470d6670c516), exposes configurable 2D content and a prefix explicitly described as supporting an external URL. In app/View/Label.php, plain_asset_tag content is the escaped configured prefix concatenated with the asset tag, whereas hardware_id/default selects the internal asset route. The UI labels the hardware route as the default and offers the plain target separately. Thus the documented default is not the complete built-in QR capability boundary.
finding_evidence.materiality: The proposal uses the private destination as a fit distinction for one of its two principal workflow candidates in research specifically requiring investigation of the optional public crate-care QR. Omitting the released configurable external URL path can misdirect the reader toward excluding that integrated label path or adding a separate label-generation mechanism. This publicly answerable exception belongs in the product comparison even though selection, ownership, deployment, and validation legitimately remain open.
finding_evidence.conditions_and_limits: New Label Engine; selected template must support 2D output; QRCODE must be selected rather than none/null; use a supported plain target with an approved prefix and compatible tag grammar. The implementation HTML-escapes the prefix, so this is not proof of arbitrary URL/query compatibility. A prefix plus tag can form a public URL; a cooperative-owned endpoint, redirects, privacy, phones, and actual printed output remain NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN. Nothing here asserts an existing care page or requires selecting Snipe-IT. The final retains the public QR option overall; the finding concerns a material product-specific capability exception, not total scope erasure.
finding_evidence.charitable_reading: The statement is true for the default path described in the rolling docs. The final does not identify its private-page statement as only that default or disclose the released external-prefix exception, and the source conditions repeat the restricted account. This makes it a material incomplete comparison rather than merely a missing exhaustive catalogue entry.

finding_evidence.title: QR Code Text/title migration is described as missing QR symbol output
finding_evidence.finding: Issue #19515 is a v8.7.1 reporter account about a hidden legacy QR Code Text/title field. Its phrase about nothing being printed does not identify QR symbol suppression. PR #19633 copies qr_text into label2_title on the disabled-to-enabled engine transition. Released rendering prepares title separately from barcode2d and writes the 2D code independently of whether title is present.
